chapters.title: Your love is better than wine
chapters.summary: The bride longs for her beloved and speaks of her sun-darkened skin. The two delight in each other. Many readers also see here God's love for His people.

chapters.title: The rose of Sharon
chapters.summary: The bride calls herself a lily among thorns. Her beloved invites her to come away, for winter is past and the flowers appear.

chapters.title: Searching at night
chapters.summary: The bride seeks her beloved through the city at night and finds him. A royal wedding procession of Solomon arrives.

chapters.title: You are all fair
chapters.summary: The groom praises his bride's beauty and calls her a garden locked, a spring sealed.

chapters.title: My beloved is gone
chapters.summary: The bride is slow to open the door, and her beloved has gone. She searches, then describes him to the daughters of Jerusalem.

chapters.title: I am my beloved's
chapters.summary: The bride knows where her beloved is: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine. He praises her as unique among all.

chapters.title: Delight in love
chapters.summary: The groom describes his bride's beauty again, and she invites him to the fields and vineyards.

chapters.title: Love is strong as death
chapters.summary: Set me as a seal upon your heart, for love is strong as death; many waters cannot quench it.
